name: mascon-bridge (ZKNS-001 identity)
notes: 94 byte descriptor documented at traincontrollerdb.marcriera.cat. Y axis is the brake/power handle, 15 discrete notches from 0x00 (EB) to 0xFF (P5). The vendor and product ids are the real device's, which is what makes the game recognise it; the names are this project's own, since the game matches on the ids alone.
